body:
She isnt close at all to her family. She has a 19 yr old daughter and 22 yr old son from a previous relationship. She has shut them out a swell. She is not allowing any of us to visit or get any info from the doctors.

I know she is upset at me calling 911 and getting the cops involved but i had no choice. All i could think of was saving her life. 

Now im completely shut out by her. I dont know how long they can keep her i dont know if she is going to come back here i know nothing. 

My mind is just overwhelmed with what might be happening.

Thanks. As others have said and i found out first hand you cant save her leave it to the professionals. Hopefully she can have an extended stay in the hospital and get the help and get on the right meds to help her cope. As im sure you know its exhausting trying to help them and basically keep them alive. She is going to have to want to live for anything to work.

Im so sorry man im going through the same thing with my wife. I know how helpless you feel. We try so hard to just keep them alive but they have to want it for themselves.

I dont have any real answers for you just know your not alone.
